Regional wheat harvest expected to top last year's yield

Favorable spring rains and a mild summer have pushed forecasters to raise their outlook for this year's wheat harvest across the tri-county farming region.
The state agriculture office now projects yields roughly nine percent above last year's totals.
Grain elevator operators say they are preparing for a busier-than-usual harvest season.
Local farmer Dana Whitfield said the early numbers are encouraging.
